verdict.rationale: The evidence suggests the source is readable: the docs list installing "from source" as an option, a community user praises active GitHub contributors, and another runs the core engine (Milli) directly as a local indexer. However, nothing in the pack names the license or confirms it is an open-source license. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, a link to the public source repository, and documentation of license terms (e.g., any restrictions on enterprise or cloud features).
